purpose: Handle reduced capacity, missed check-ins, incapacity and death without turning silence into an automatic destructive trigger.
name: CONTINUITY GATE
anti_pattern: DEAD-MAN SWITCH THAT PUBLISHES/DELETES/TRANSFERS ON A TIMER ALONE

evidence_ladder.name: independent_channel_failure
may: escalate to named human check if pre-authorized

evidence_ladder.name: trusted_human_attestation
may: enter HUMAN_CHECK or HANDOFF_CONFIRMED depending contract
must_not: execute irreversible legacy actions unless separately authorized

evidence_ladder.name: authoritative_or_explicit_confirmation
may: release only pre-authorized bounded handoff packets
must_not: broaden authority beyond the stored contract

handoff_packet.design: prewritten, bounded, reversible where possible, named recipient, explicit scope and expiry/review
handoff_packet.secret_rule: Secrets and credentials remain in private storage; public HUMAN PORT only exposes instructions to use the proper private handoff channel.

health_boundary: HUMAN PORT may expose communication capacity or handoff state, not medical diagnosis or detailed health/lifestyle state, unless the owner explicitly authors such a projection.
experiment_boundary: Routine/training/lifestyle experiments may exist as private context refs that modulate expected availability or response latency; they are not public by default.
return_rule: Every continuity transition records evidence, actor, before/after state, uncertainty and next allowed actions.

retained: silence or staleness is not evidence of danger
preserve devices/files and prefer reversible actions
private handoff information stays outside the public repository
